react_result.final_narrative_text: The eight differentially abundant metabolites form a coherent lipid-mediator signature that converges on arachidonic acid metabolism. Across three independent enrichment paradigms — RaMP multi-database ORA, MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA, and Mummichog m/z-network analysis — the top-scoring pathway is arachidonic acid metabolism (KEGG:hsa00590, MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism), with five of the eight input compounds mapping directly into this module: arachidonic acid (C00219), leukotriene A4 (C00909), 5-HETE (C04805), 15-HETE (C04742), and 15-deoxy-d-12,14-PGJ2 (C14717). RaMP returned this as WP:WP167 "Eicosanoid synthesis" (FDR 3.16e-13, fold-enrichment 1251, rank 0/14), MetaboAnalystR returned it as KEGG:hsa00590 (rank 0), and Mummichog returned it as "Arachidonic acid metabolism" (p=0.0045, rank 0 with 11 overlapping compounds). The leukotriene branch is independently supported by RaMP rank-1 (SMPDB:SMP00353 "Leukotriene C4 Synthesis Deficiency", FDR 8.28e-13) and Mummichog rank-3 (Leukotriene metabolism, p=0.045). Arachidonic acid (C00219) is the canonical upstream substrate shared by both the prostaglandin/J-series and the leukotriene branches. 5-HETE (C04805) and 15-HETE (C04742) are the direct lipoxygenase products of the 5-LOX and 15-LOX pathways respectively, and 15d-PGJ2 (C14717) is the cyclopentenone prostaglandin derived from prostaglandin D2 dehydration. Acetylcysteine (C06809), fructose 1-phosphate (C01094), and dopamine (C03758) did not contribute to the lipid-mediator pathways and are not enriched in any top-ranked result.

final_react_result.final_narrative_text: Three complementary enrichment paradigms were applied to eight differentially abundant metabolites. RaMP multi-database ORA returned Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) as the top pathway with FDR 3.16e-13, hitting five of the eight input compounds: 15-deoxy-d-12,14-PGJ2, arachidonic acid, 5-HETE, 15-HETE, and leukotriene A4. Mummichog m/z-network analysis independently returned Arachidonic acid metabolism (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism) as its top hit with p=0.00277, with four overlapping driver compounds shared with the RaMP result: arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 15-HETE, and 5-HETE. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA identified KEGG:hsa00590 as its top-ranked pathway, also containing arachidonic acid and the same HETE and leukotriene A4 hits. Arachidonic acid (KEGG:C00219) is the shared upstream substrate driving both the prostaglandin/J-series branch (producing 15d-PGJ2) and the leukotriene branch (producing LTA4), with 5-HETE and 15-HETE as lipoxygenase-derived intermediate products. Acetylcysteine (KEGG:C06809), fructose 1-phosphate (KEGG:C01094), and dopamine (KEGG:C03758) did not appear in any top-ranked pathway, indicating the lipid-mediator network is the primary biological system perturbed by the treatment.
